hints.title: Complete Set Round
hints.text: Every valid roll sequence of length 1 can be formed if and only if all values from 1 to k appear at least once.

hints.title: Sequence Extension Rounds
hints.text: Every valid roll sequence of length L can be extended to length L + 1 if and only if a complete set of 1 to k values is observed afterward.

hints.title: Round Accumulator
hints.text: Track distinct elements in a set. Each time the set size reaches k, increment completed rounds and clear the set.

hints.title: Greedy Set Rounds Implementation

variables: k: number of distinct dice faces
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all k^L combinations causes exponential blowup.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Set size bounded by k distinct integers.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes the greedy round property: any sequence of length L requires L consecutive complete covers of 1..k.
